passages.text: A Joyful Day of Art, Vision, and Innovation at the de Young Museum Community engagement and cultural access are at the heart of Zenni’s CSR ethos. As the presenting sponsor at the annual family event at San Francisco’s de Young Museum, Zenni hosted over 250 vision screenings (including innovative VR-based evaluations), introduced children and adults to our cutting-edge EyeQLenz™ with ID Guard™ technology, and provided high-quality protective glasses to attendees. Brand ambassador George Kittle contributed star power and inspiration, underscoring our belief that creativity and health are interconnected. every style. ## Harnessing the Power of Social Strategies Social media has become an integral part of how we connect with customers on a more personal level. Our social media campaigns are designed to engage, inspire, and inform. By leveraging platforms like Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and Twitter, we create content that resonates with our audience. Additionally, we prioritize fostering a sense of community and trust, alongside offering educational content. This strategy strengthens our relationships with customers and ensures they are well-informed and confident in their interactions with our brand.

Mental Health, Movement, and the “I Run For” Campaign May saw the launch of Zenni’s “I Run For…” campaign led by Chase Stokes and in partnership with Bring Change to Mind. Focusing on the powerful connection between movement and mindfulness, the campaign merged community engagement, such as sponsoring the NYCRUNS Summer Loving Fest, with product innovation in the Zunnies™ sports sunglasses line. Notably, 1% of all Zunnies™ proceeds in May supported youth mental health programs, advancing open conversations and destigmatizing mental health issues. Learn more about “I Run For…”

Partnering for Equity: Community Goods and Chicago Zenni partnered with Community Goods in Chicago, delivering free vision screenings, and EyeQLenz glasses to local children. This partnership underscores our conviction in the transformative power of creative after-school programs and holistic wellness, particularly for underserved communities. Every event is driven by our passionate volunteers, who ensure support, information, and inspiration reach every family.
